narr: Low pressure moved north along the Atlantic Seaboard spreading steady and heavy rain into central New York during the overnight hours. Rainfall amounts of 2 to 4 inches were observed along with a considerable amount of melting snow into area rivers and streams. Widespread flash flooding and river flooding occurred during this event.

A tributary to the Chenango River is flooding and threatening to overtop a bridge. Extensive lowland flooding along the river's main channel is also happening.
